Economist Radoslaw Stefanski used Gemini to analyze ~23,000 English-language books and identify what values each book discussed, and whether those values were endorsed, condemned, or described objectively.

He tallied up how texts have treated several values—most importantly hierarchy, fear of the unknown, autonomy, and patience—to calculate the evolving cultural “stock” of each:
posts.summary: Documents shift in literary values toward egalitarianism, away from hierarchy

posts.text:
During the Obama administration, schools were put under the threat of investigation if suspension rates were different by race.

A student was violent, or brought a weapon to school? It didn't matter. Schools were still under the threat of investigation. 

"They were really concerned about aggregate statistics and not concerned about the underlying behavior...so a lot of schools stopped reporting when things were happening. But that didn't stop the violence from happening."

@CarolynGorman_ spok
